result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues make the restaurant discovery UI look broken: truncated names, cut-off cards, and incomplete category chips.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' restaurant card is heavily clipped on the right edge, showing only part of the image and a truncated name ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels fully display cards or use consistent peek/padding so names and images are not cut off mid-content.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated, likely missing the end of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line names, reduce font size, or ellipsize cleanly with enough visible characters so names remain identifiable.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial chip visible after 'Healthy'), suggesting overflow without clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll indication, padding, or wrap/scroll the chip list so the last visible chip is not sliced.

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' promo card is partially cut off by the tab bar, hiding lower content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so cards are fully visible when scrolled to the end.

issues.description: Delivery time badges overlay food images with varying contrast and placement, and the middle card badge sits lower, looking slightly inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge position, size, and background opacity across cards for a cleaner grid.
